dataset: Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework v3
coordinateNote: Coordinates are Allen CCF origin coordinates, not bregma stereotaxic coordinates. Voxel sample position in micrometers equals its index times spacing.
nrrdHeaderNote: Original NRRDs label their space left-posterior-superior; the Allen API documentation explicitly defines anatomical array axes as AP,SI,LR in PIR orientation. This viewer uses that anatomical convention without transposing the original raster.

meshFormat.name: allen-mesh-v1
meshFormat.vertices: vertexCount * 3 float32 at byte 8, coordinates in micrometers, AP/DV/ML order
meshFormat.triangles: triangleCount * 3 uint32 at byte 8 + vertexCount * 12, zero-based vertex indices
meshFormat.processing: Official Allen CCFv3 2017 OBJ vertices and triangle indices, packed without spatial resampling or mesh simplification; original vertex normals omitted and recomputed by the renderer.

provenance.templateDescription: Shape and background fluorescence intensity average of 1,675 serial two-photon tomography mouse brains. This is a registered reference volume, not an individual specimen or MRI.
provenance.processing: Lossless repack of official NRRD payloads. No resampling, relabeling, generated anatomy, or intensity scaling.

reference.title: The Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework: A 3D Reference Atlas
